description: A split layout: an oversized heading on a primary colour panel with a short intro and a button, and the accordion beside it.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: The six we hear most about Billfold. For anything else, a real person replies within one working day.

itemFields.name: question
itemFields.label: Question
itemFields.default: Can I add my own logo?

itemFields.name: answer
itemFields.label: Answer
itemFields.default: Yes. Upload it once and it appears on every invoice, quote and receipt.

default.question: Is there a free plan?
default.answer: Yes. Send up to five invoices a month for free, for as long as you like. You do not need a card to sign up.

default.question: How do my clients pay?
default.answer: By card, bank transfer or direct debit, straight from the invoice. The money reaches your own account in two working days.

default.question: What does Billfold take per payment?
default.answer: 1.2% on card payments, capped at £4 an invoice. Bank transfers and direct debits cost nothing.

default.question: Can I bring invoices from another tool?
default.answer: Yes. Upload an export from FreeAgent, Xero or a spreadsheet, and your clients, items and invoice numbers carry on where they stopped.

default.question: Does it chase late payers for me?
default.answer: If you want it to. Polite reminders go out 3, 10 and 21 days after the due date, in your own words, and stop the moment you are paid.

default.question: Can I cancel whenever I like?
default.answer: Yes, in two clicks from the settings page. You keep read-only access to every invoice for seven years.
